text_block_list.text:
It was time for training, but Symboli 
Rudolf hadn't shown up, so I went to check 
the student council room...

I found Symboli Rudolf nodding off, almost 
buried beneath a mountain of paperwork.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Allow me to wipe it for you... To 
wipe... the President... Heheh."

...She looked so peaceful asleep, so I 
decided to let her rest for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry for breaking our plans 
today.
choice_data_list: I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. To ensure I do not repeat the same 
mistake, I intend to turn over a new leaf 
and better myself...!
